overview.description: The ALPS Barron's 400 ETF (BFOR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Barron's 400 index. The fund tracks an equally weighted index comprising 400 US companies selected on fundamental parameters. BFOR was launched on Jun 4, 2013 and is issued by SS&C.
